C0845.title: Microsoft and OpenAI Joint Research: Hacker Groups from Multiple Countries Leverage ChatGPT and Other AI Tools to Escalate Cyberattacks
C0845.summary: In February 2024, joint research by Microsoft and OpenAI revealed that hacker groups from Russia, North Korea, and Iran are using generative AI tools like ChatGPT for target research, script refinement, and social engineering tactics.
